# LinkedUp Cars Rentals

> Nairobi-based car hire and chauffeur service — self-drive rentals, airport transfers, corporate transport, staff shuttles and game-drive vehicles. Instant online booking with M-Pesa.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Fleet highlights, pricing snapshot, and instant booking entry point.
- [Browse Cars](/cars): Full fleet — luxury, SUV, saloon, budget and utility vehicles with live availability.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Booking flow, documents required, deposits, delivery and return process.
- [About](/about): Company background, service areas across Nairobi, Kiambu Road, Ridgeways, Westlands and Karen.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions on eligibility, insurance, mileage, extensions, delivery and payments.
- [Insights](/insights): Articles on car hire in Kenya, travel guides, and self-drive tips.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, WhatsApp and office locations.
